title: Process_FindSandboxed lock and IRQL release

contains.const: Process_Find owns the Process_ListLock and raised-IRQL transfer contract when out_irql is non-null

contracts: Process_Find owns the Process_ListLock and raised-IRQL transfer contract when out_irql is non-null
Process_Find raises to APC_LEVEL and acquires Process_ListLock before returning a protected PROCESS pointer
Process_Find without out_irql releases Process_ListLock and lowers IRQL before return
Process_Find with out_irql stores the old IRQL for the caller and leaves Process_ListLock held
Process_FindSandboxed may filter a found PROCESS when bHostInject is set
Process_FindSandboxed returning NULL after bHostInject filtering releases Process_ListLock when out_irql is non-null
Process_FindSandboxed returning NULL after bHostInject filtering lowers IRQL using the old IRQL from out_irql
Process_FindSandboxed does not release Process_ListLock for NULL returned directly by Process_Find
Process_FindSandboxed leaves successful sandboxed PROCESS ownership and caller-release topology unchanged
runtime_gates: Windows driver build with XP_SUPPORT enabled for process.c
kernel smoke where Process_FindSandboxed finds a normal sandboxed process with out_irql and caller releases Process_ListLock and lowers IRQL
kernel smoke where Process_FindSandboxed filters a bHostInject process with out_irql and returns NULL without leaving Process_ListLock held
kernel smoke where Process_FindSandboxed receives PROCESS_TERMINATED and preserves the sentinel plus caller-owned release contract
Driver Verifier or debugger observation proving no leaked ERESOURCE ownership or raised IRQL on the bHostInject filtered path
